title: Help/Ideas for a 1 hour workshop for 12 year olds on Filmmaking

commenti.body:
It's not going to fill much of the hour, but in terms of effort-to-impact, zoetrope animation is a real crowd-pleaser.

I know you could just show a video, but it should be relatively simple to construct a suitable carousel, even if it's just out of card, and that will satisfy the hands-on requirement (you might want to prepare a back-up or two, if you do go for the flimsy DIY option). If you can somehow pull off a 3D-zoetrope, then you'll have everybody losing their minds, but this would naturally be much more time consuming.

Hard to know when in the hour to show it, however. It's absolutely fundamental to filmmaking, so it makes sense to lead with it, but the remainder of the hour will need to be equally engaging, which might be tough to achieve.
